title: Docs: Data residency region pinning (Hosted) — configuration, limitations, and troubleshooting
author: Wei Chen
description: This PR adds public documentation for Hosted data residency enforcement via region pinning. It covers: (1) what region pinning guarantees, (2) how to configure allowed regions + primary region in the Console and via Admin API (where available), (3) enforcement behavior (routing + fallback constraints) and common failure modes, (4) the public error contract for residency violations (HTTP status, error_code, request_id, help_url), and (5) troubleshooting steps and support-ready guidance. The content is aligned with the current gateway contract (409 on deterministic policy block) and clarifies limitations/non-goals (no automatic multi-region replication; some non-content account metadata may be processed outside the pinned region). It also includes copy for streaming vs non-streaming behavior and points users to audit log + blocked-request views in Console. Internal-only implementation details are intentionally omitted; this is customer-facing guidance only. Docs note: terminology standardized to “Allowed regions” and “Primary region” per Product guidance; avoids “geo-fencing” language.

notable_snippets: Example: residency policy violation (non-streaming) => HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict; body: {"error":{"type":"policy_error","error_code":"RESIDENCY_POLICY_VIOLATION","message":"Request blocked: project is pinned to EU regions (primary: eu-west). This request would be processed in us-east due to routing constraints.","request_id":"req_01HTR8J2Y8Q3K3F2K0W9M2Q6B7","help_url":"https://docs.redwoodinference.com/security/data-residency/troubleshooting#residency-policy-violation","details":{"allowed_regions":"eu-west, eu-central","selected_region":"us-east","policy_scope":"project","policy_id":"rpolj_8fQx..."}}}

Example: streaming behavior => if blocked before tokens are emitted, server returns 409 with the same JSON error payload; if tokens already started, the stream is terminated with an error frame containing error_code=RESIDENCY_POLICY_VIOLATION and request_id (SDKs surface this as a dedicated exception).

Configuration summary => Allowed regions controls where customer content may be processed; Primary region is the preferred processing region within the allowed set. Cross-region fallback is disabled by default when pinning is enabled.
